note: Golden allocation baseline for the #63 shadow scenarios. Allocation is deterministic (measured <0.1% run-to-run) and is the HARD gate. Latency is machine-dependent and CI-noisy, so it is ADVISORY only (reported for trend, never fails the run). Regenerate after an intentional change: run the sample (`dotnet run -c Release -- report.json`) and copy the AllocatedBytes values here; latency values are a local reference. Per-metric thresholds below are overridable via the SHADOW_ALLOC_PCT / SHADOW_LATENCY_PCT workflow env vars.
